snippet.title: Kingdom III: Rising Realms - Gameplay Preview
snippet.description:
The world is shattered, but is all lost? In this video Angelica, Game Director for Kingdom III: Rising Realms, will take you on a journey into the unknown and let you get a glimpse of what Raw Fury and Fury Studios are building in the next installment of the beloved Kingdom game series. 

About Kingdom III: Rising Realms 

Protect your crown! Kingdom returns in an all-new micro-strategy and tower defense game set in a shattered realm. Embark on an atmospheric adventure across lands of legend to build a lasting legacy and challenge the empowered Greed threat. Coming 2027 to XBOX Series X|S, Cloud and PC. Wishlist today!
